paragraphs.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints that are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν [ἐν Ἐφέσῳ] καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·
paragraphs.translit: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos theou tois hagiois tois ousin [en Ephesō] kai pistois en Christō Iēsou·

paragraphs.text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: charis hymin kai eirēnē apo theou patros hēmōn kai kyriou Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly [places] in Christ:
paragraphs.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ,
paragraphs.translit: Eulogētos ho theos kai patēr tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou, ho eulogēsas hēmas en pasē eulogia pneumatikē en tois epouraniois en Christō,

paragraphs.text: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blemish before him in love:
paragraphs.original: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ,
paragraphs.translit: kathōs exelexato hēmas en autō pro katabolēs kosmou, einai hēmas hagious kai amōmous katenōpion autou en agapē,

paragraphs.text: having foreordained us unto adoption as sons through Jesus Christ unto himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
paragraphs.original: προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: proorisas hēmas eis hyiothesian dia Iēsou Christou eis auton, kata tēn eudokian tou thelēmatos autou,

paragraphs.text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely bestowed on us in the Beloved:
paragraphs.original: εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ,
paragraphs.translit: eis epainon doxēs tēs charitos autou hēs echaritōsen hēmas en tō ēgapēmenō,

paragraphs.text: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων, κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ
paragraphs.translit: en hō echomen tēn apolytrōsin dia tou haimatos autou, tēn aphesin tōn paraptōmatōn, kata to ploutos tēs charitos autou

paragraphs.text: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
paragraphs.original: ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει
paragraphs.translit: hēs eperisseusen eis hēmas en pasē sophia kai phronēsei

paragraphs.text: making known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
paragraphs.original: γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ
paragraphs.translit: gnōrisas hēmin to mystērion tou thelēmatos autou, kata tēn eudokian autou hēn proetheto en autō

paragraphs.text: unto a dispensation of the fulness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things upon the earth; in him, [I say,]
paragraphs.original: εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν, ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἐν αὐτῷ,
paragraphs.translit: eis oikonomian tou plērōmatos tōn kairōn, anakephalaiōsasthai ta panta en tō Christō, ta epi tois ouranois kai ta epi tēs gēs· en autō,

paragraphs.text: in whom also we were made a heritage, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his will;
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: en hō kai eklērōthēmen prooristhentes kata prothesin tou ta panta energountos kata tēn boulēn tou thelēmatos autou,

paragraphs.text: to the end that we should be unto the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:
paragraphs.original: εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ·
paragraphs.translit: eis to einai hēmas eis epainon doxēs autou tous proēlpikotas en tō Christō·

paragraphs.text: in whom ye also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation,-- in whom, having also believed, ye were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,
paragraphs.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ ἁγίῳ,
paragraphs.translit: en hō kai hymeis akousantes ton logon tēs alētheias, to euangelion tēs sōtērias hymōn, en hō kai pisteusantes esphragisthēte tō pneumati tēs epangelias tō hagiō,

paragraphs.text: which is an earnest of our inheritance, unto the redemption of [God`s] own possession, unto the praise of his glory.
paragraphs.original: ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho estin arrabōn tēs klēronomias hēmōn, eis apolytrōsin tēs peripoiēseōs, eis epainon tēs doxēs autou.

paragraphs.text: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which [ye show] toward all the saints,
paragraphs.original: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ, ἀκούσας τὴν καθʼ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,
paragraphs.translit: Dia touto kagō, akousas tēn kathʼ hymas pistin en tō kyriō Iēsou kai tēn agapēn tēn eis pantas tous hagious,

paragraphs.text: cease not to give thanks for you, making mention [of you] in my prayers;
paragraphs.original: οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,
paragraphs.translit: ou pauomai eucharistōn hyper hymōn mneian poioumenos epi tōn proseuchōn mou,

paragraphs.text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
paragraphs.original: ἵνα ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ πατὴρ τῆς δόξης, δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: hina ho theos tou kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou, ho patēr tēs doxēs, dōē hymin pneuma sophias kai apokalypseōs en epignōsei autou,

paragraphs.text: having the eyes of your heart enlightened, that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
paragraphs.original: πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ, τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις,
paragraphs.translit: pephōtismenous tous ophthalmous tēs kardias hymōn eis to eidenai hymas tis estin hē elpis tēs klēseōs autou, tis ho ploutos tēs doxēs tēs klēronomias autou en tois hagiois,

paragraphs.text: and what the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
paragraphs.original: καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ
paragraphs.translit: kai ti to hyperballon megethos tēs dynameōs autou eis hēmas tous pisteuontas kata tēn energeian tou kratous tēs ischyos autou

paragraphs.text: which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly [places],
paragraphs.original: ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις
paragraphs.translit: hēn enērgēken en tō Christō egeiras auton ek nekrōn, kai kathisas en dexia autou en tois epouraniois

paragraphs.text: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
paragraphs.original: ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι·
paragraphs.translit: hyperanō pasēs archēs kai exousias kai dynameōs kai kyriotētos kai pantos onomatos onomazomenou ou monon en tō aiōni toutō alla kai en tō mellonti·

paragraphs.text: and he put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things to the church,
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντα ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ,
paragraphs.translit: kai panta hypetaxen hypo tous podas autou, kai auton edōken kephalēn hyper panta tē ekklēsia,

paragraphs.text: which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
paragraphs.original: ἥτις ἐστὶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ, τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν πληρουμένου.
paragraphs.translit: hētis estin to sōma autou, to plērōma tou ta panta en pasin plēroumenou.
